The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
History:  User has  extensive experience with cocaine, morphine, lortab, xanax, etizolam, 5-MEO-MIPT, 2-5i-NboMe, Marijuana, synthetic Marijuana of every kind, LSD-25, Mushrooms, Dextromethorphan, Dextrorphan, Nicotine, Caffiene, Ethylphenidate, Ethanol, 5-APDB, MDMA, 4-MEC, Pentadrone, A-PVP, A-PPP, Adderall, and a few others which slip my mind at the time.
Mindset:  Relaxed in my own home with other room mates who are not drug users.  No depression or NEED to escape reality.
Time Elapse:  T+00-  Insufflated ~50mg, effects felt almost immediately.  Warm comfort blanket encompasses my psyche.  For most this may be a frightening experience, but if you are used to the shift in cognitive processes than it isn't at all unsettling.
T+30- Insufflated ~50 mg, same as before.  The realization that I am no longer in a state of mind to function properly outside of home.  Very introspective.
T+1.00- Insufflated ~50mg, same as before.  The build of the chemical is really starting to cause of a major shift in perspective and reasoning; slurred speech, empathy.
T+1.30- Insufflated ~50mg MXE, 1 mg Etizolam, ~60mg Ethylphenidate, and ! strong beverage of Coke and Jack Daniel's
T+2.00- Insufflated ~ 150mg MXE.  This is where it got interesting.  I no longer had any sense of reality.  My body was completely separated from my mind, I could levitate and mold myself into objects while always being remolded back into myself.  Subdued fear kicked in at this point as I have never before experienced anything of this sort.  I was transported physically to a courtroom of souls where I was given warning about who I am and what I must to in order to be successful in this life.  The speaker was none other than God Himself and beside him sat 3 Archangels. I was told many things pertaining to the sins I had committed and that the use of these substances is forbidden.
T+2.5-  Slowly coming back to reality.  I get up and fall flat on the ground.  I stumble my way to my bedroom and lay with my girlfriend and our daughter and enjoy the silence.
Overview-  I  in NO WAY SHAPE OR FORM RECOMMEND THE DOSAGES OF METHOXETAMINE THAT I TOOK!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  I have a very high tolerance to dissacciatives.
